nodes.question: What has historically influenced agriculture and land use policy creation in the State?
nodes.answer: Agriculture and land use policy creation in the State has historically been influenced by external donors.
nodes.paragraph: Agriculture and land use policy creation in the State has historically been diffuse, with programs largely influenced by the direction of external donors. This has made it diffi- cult for central coordination and tracking of progress. The State has recently defined ambitions for forestry and land use, signaling the emergence of more for - mal direction setting and greater prioritization of land use topics. However, it notes that there is a signifi- cant need to bridge the gap between agricultural and forestry agendas (Ekiti State Forestry Commission 2021a). Spatial mapping and understanding of land use across Nigeria have been extremely limited, with only a handful of academic studies (e.g., Olorunfemi et al. 2020; Fasona et al. 2020; Abbas et al. 2018; Akiny - emi 2013; Koranteng et al. 2016), and two national land cover surveys conducted since 1976 (Fasona et al. 2020).
